evidence_basis: CIO review round 1 on PR #211 (2026-08-22): cadence values mirror the 'Opportunity Capture Control Loop' design doc section 6 ('재검토 시계' -- price/flow triggers next trading day/24h, long-thesis triggers 30 days). These are engineering scheduling defaults for an MVP, not a ratified investment threshold/risk policy -- see approval_status. A future CIO ratification pass may revise every numeric value here without any code change (clock/dynamic_clock.py reads this file, not a hardcoded dict).

BTC.note: BTC trades continuously; every calendar day is a trading day. No holiday-calendar ambiguity is possible for this market.

CRYPTO.note: Crypto breadth pairs trade continuously; every calendar day is a trading day.

KOREA.note: No KRX public-holiday calendar is committed anywhere in this repo's evidence (checked: no config/*holiday* file, no krx.json holiday field). cooldown/expiry/next_review_at for KOREA are computed by skipping Saturday/Sunday ONLY -- a real KRX public holiday inside that window would silently NOT be skipped. Every KOREA-market date derived from this policy therefore carries an explicit uncertainty_flag (see clock/dynamic_clock.py::CalendarConfidence) rather than presenting a confident date. Do not remove holiday_calendar_verified:false without first committing real, sourced KRX holiday-calendar evidence.
